content.title: About
content.content: Meatballs NS are a ready‑to‑eat product made from ground meat (beef, pork or a blend) seasoned with aromatic spices and served with sauce (1265). They heat quickly and work as a main dish or a side to various accompaniments.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Meatballs are a staple in many cuisines, from Italian “polpette” to Swedish “köttbullar”.
Sauce (1265) is a proprietary tomato‑based sauce with hints of basil and garlic, created especially for NS meatballs.
The product is thermally processed at 80 °C, ensuring safety while preserving juiciness.
Meatballs can be stored frozen for up to 12 months without loss of flavor.
A 150 g serving provides roughly 250 kcal, fitting well into a balanced diet.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: The meat base supplies high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Beef and pork contain heme iron, which is readily absorbed by the body.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Meatballs provide B12, niacin, and riboflavin, supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Low in carbs
items.content: Ideal for low‑carb diets as the primary component is meat.

items.title: Beneficial plant additives
items.content: Sauce (1265) includes tomatoes and basil, rich in antioxidants.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to beef or pork.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Sauce (1265) contains salt; people monitoring sodium intake should account for it.

items.title: Requires thorough heating
items.content: Insufficiently heated meatballs may harbor harmful bacteria.

items.title: Calorie density in large portions
items.content: Consuming overly large servings can lead to excess calorie intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meatballs in the microwave (2‑3 min) or on a skillet, drizzle with sauce (1265) and serve with a side such as mashed potatoes, rice, or a vegetable salad.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen meatballs in a freezer at –18 °C. Once thawed, use within 24 hours and do not refreeze.
